NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's web site under City Council Meeting agendas at www.RollingHillsEstates.gov and
  during regular business hours in the office of the City Clerk. Meetings are live broadcast on the City's web
  site and a recording is available for viewing after each meeting. Meetings are also broadcast on PVP -TV
  Channel 35 (Cox) and Channel 39 (Verizon).

  Public Comment is welcome on any item during City Council consideration of the item. An opportunity is
  also provided for the public to comment on non-agenda items concerning City matters. If you would like to
  address the City Council regarding an item on this agenda or make a general public comment, please
  complete a speaker sheet and give to the City Clerk.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

3.  ROLL CALL

4.  CEREMONIAL ITEMS

5.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  City Council. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless good cause is shown by a member
  prior to the roll call vote. (Items removed for individual consideration will be voted on separately.)

  A.  READING OF ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
  Reading in full of all ordinances and resolutions presented for consideration to the
  City Council will be waived and all such ordinances and resolutions will be read by

MINUTES
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JANUARY 13, 2026

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

MAYOR STEGURA called the meeting to order at 7:01 p.m.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

Led by MAYOR STEGURA.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan

City Council Members Absent:  None

City Staff Present:  City Manager Greg Grammer
  Assistant City Attorney Stephen McEwen
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  Community Dev/Public Works Director Jeannie Naughton
  City Clerk Lauren Pettit
  Assistant to the City Manager Jessica Slawson

4.  CEREMONIAL ITEMS

None.

5.  CONSENT CALENDAR

The following routine matters will be acted upon by one vote to approve with the majority consent of the City
Council. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless good cause is shown by a member prior to the
roll call vote. (Items removed will be considered under New Business.)

COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN recused himself from item 5F as he was not present for
the December 16, 2025 City Council meeting.

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF, TO
  APPROVE CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS 5A-H AS FOLLOWS BY THE
  FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

  APPROVED.

  RECEIVED AND FILE.

  RECEIVED AND FILE.

 F.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF DECEMBER 16, 2025

  REVIEWED AND APPROVED.

G.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF DECEMBER 17, 2025

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

H.  2025 TRACY AUSTIN DOUBLES TENNIS TOURNAMENT DEBRIEF

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

6.  PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

None.

7.  PUBLIC HEARINGS

A.  RESOLUTION NO. 2615 APPROVING THE PROPOSED USE OF FISCAL YEAR
  2026-27 COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) FUNDS

  Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Open the Public Hearing; 2) Receive any
  public testimony; 3) Close the Public Hearing; and, 4) Waive further reading and
  approve Resolution No. 2615 authorizing execution of a contract with the Los Angeles
  County Community Development Commission for participation in the program for
  funding of the 2026-2027 ADA Access Ramp and Sidewalk Improvement Program
  (Year 13) as identified in the Program and Conditions Assessment Report dated April
  2, 2014 in the amount of $19,834.

Community Development & Public Works Director Naughton provided a staff report (as per
the agenda material).

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by MAYOR PRO TEM
  SCHACHTER, TO OPEN THE PUBLIC HEARING.

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chamber, via email and via eComment.
No public testimony was received.

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by MAYOR PRO TEM
  SCHACHTER, TO CLOSE THE PUBLIC HEARING.

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by MAYOR PRO TEM
  SCHACHTER, TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL
  VOTE:

  APPROVE RESOLUTION NO. 2615 AUTHORIZING EXECUTION OF A
  CONTRACT WITH THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION FOR PARTICIPATION IN THE PROGRAM
  FOR FUNDING OF THE 2026-2027 ADA ACCESS RAMP AND SIDEWALK
  IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM (YEAR 13) AS IDENTIFIED IN THE PROGRAM
  AND CONDITIONS ASSESSMENT REPORT DATED APRIL 2, 2014 IN THE
  AMOUNT OF $19,834.

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

City Clerk Pettit read Resolution No. 2615 by title.

8.  NEW BUSINESS

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by MAYOR PRO TEM
  SCHACHTER, TO ADJOURN TO THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD
  MEETING.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  2
JANUARY 13, 2026
 **ADJOURN TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD MEETING**

A.  PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ANNUAL BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING

  Recommendation: That the Rolling Hills Estates Pepper Tree Foundation Board of
  Directors receive and file this report.

Assistant City Manager Davis provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

Assistant City Manager Davis explained the various project balances in attachment B which
carry over year-to-year, in response to BOARD MEMBER HUFF.

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chamber, via email and via eComment.
No public testimony was received.

  BOARD MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by VICE CHAIR SCHACHTER, TO
  APPROVE AS FOLLOWS:

  RECEIVE AND FILE.

CHAIR STEGURA so ordered.

  BOARD MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by VICE CHAIR SCHACHTER, TO
  RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING.

**RECONVENE CITY COUNCIL MEETING**

B.  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION ACTION ITEM: PROPOSED SILVER SPUR
  LITTLE LEAGUE AGREEMENT

  Recommendation: That the City Council approve the attached 2026 Agreement with
  Silver Spur Little League for use of Ernie Howlett Park’s sports fields.

Assistant City Manager Davis provided a staff report (as per the agenda material), noting
that Field C has been removed from the proposed agreement.

Assistant City Manager Davis explained that staff is recommending a one-year term as the
league transitions through leadership changes, in response to COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF.

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chamber, via email and via eComment.
No public testimony was received.

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by MAYOR PRO TEM
  SCHACHTER, TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL
  VOTE:

  APPROVE THE 2026 AGREEMENT WITH SILVER SPUR LITTLE LEAGUE,
  AMENDED TO REMOVE FIELD C FROM THE AGREEMENT, FOR USE OF
  FIELDS A AND B AT ERNIE HOWLETT PARK’S SPORTS FIELDS.

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

9.  OLD BUSINESS

A.  SECOND READING AND ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 759 AMENDING RHEMC
  CHAPTER 3.38 (UPCCAA ADOPTION) AND ORDINANCE NO. 760 ADDING RHEMC
  CHAPTER 3.40 (PUBLIC PROJECT CONTRACTING POLICY)

  Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Hold the second reading and adopt
  proposed Ordinance No. 759 amending and restating municipal code chapter 3.38
  (re-titled “Public Project Contracting - UPCCAA Adoption”); and 2) Hold the second

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  3
JANUARY 13, 2026
   reading and adopt proposed Ordinance No. 760 adding municipal code chapter 3.40
  (“Public Project Contracting Policy”).

Assistant City Attorney McEwen provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chamber, via email and via eComment.
No public testimony was received.

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ moved, seconded by MAYOR PRO TEM
  SCHACHTER, TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL
  VOTE:

  ADOPT PROPOSED ORDINANCE NO. 759 AMENDING AND RESTATING
  MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER 3.38 (RE-TITLED “PUBLIC PROJECT
  CONTRACTING - UPCCAA ADOPTION”).

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

City Clerk Pettit read Ordinance No. 759 by title.

  MAYOR PRO TEM SCHACHTER moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER
  SCHMITZ, TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  ADOPT PROPOSED ORDINANCE NO. 760 ADDING MUNICIPAL CODE
  CHAPTER 3.40 (“PUBLIC PROJECT CONTRACTING POLICY”).

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

City Clerk Pettit read Ordinance No. 760 by title.

B.  ADOPTION OF PUBLIC PROJECT CONTRACTING POLICY

  Recommendation: That the City Council adopt Resolution No. 2614 establishing a
  Public Project Contracting Policy.

Assistant City Attorney McEwen provided a staff report (as per the agenda material).

Public comment was invited in-person in the Council Chamber, via email and via eComment.
No public testimony was received.

  MAYOR PRO TEM SCHACHTER moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF,
  TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. 2614 ESTABLISHING A PUBLIC PROJECT
  CONTRACTING POLICY.

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

City Clerk Pettit read Resolution No. 2614 by title.

10.  CITY ATTORNEY ITEMS

None.

11.  CITY COUNCIL/REGIONAL COMMITTEE REPORTS

COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF attended the Cal Cities Los Angeles County Division membership
meeting last week in Torrance, joined by MAYOR PRO TEM SCHACHTER and COUNCIL
MEMBER SCHMITZ.

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  4
JANUARY 13, 2026
 COUNCIL MEMBER SCHMITZ reported on the California Contract Cities Annual Legislative
Tour in Sacramento earlier in the month, attended along with MAYOR STEGURA, MAYOR
PRO TEM SCHACHTER and COUNCIL MEMBER HUFF.

MAYOR STEGURA will be attending the Peninsula Mayor’s lunch and Los Angeles County
Sanitation District Board meeting tomorrow, as well as the Clean Power Alliance Board meeting
on Thursday.

12.  MAYOR AND COUNCIL ITEMS

A.  AUTHORIZATION TO ATTEND THE CAL CITIES 2026 MAYORS AND COUNCIL
  MEMBERS ACADEMY, JANUARY 21-23, 2026, HYATT REGENCY SACRAMENTO,
  CA

  CONSENSUS FOR ANY AND ALL COUNCIL MEMBERS TO ATTEND.

13.  CLOSED SESSION

None.

14.  ADJOURNMENT

At 7:44 p.m. MAYOR STEGURA adjourned the meeting in memory of Eileen Hupp, former
President and CEO of the Palos Verdes Peninsula Chamber of Commerce. The meeting
was adjourned to Tuesday, January 27, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. for the purpose of a regular
meeting.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit, City Clerk  Debby Stegura, Mayor
